svg.desc: Single editable master. The original choice-A bunny pixels are embedded unchanged and clipped out of their old ring. The new 76-unit ring has identical openings along the -45/135-degree RustDesk diagonal. Its second half is a 180-degree reuse, not a separately drawn path. The foreground bunny intentionally overlaps the left ring. This is an independent companion, not an official RustDesk logo.
